name: Glendenning Road Data Centre - Stage 1

address.note: campus address, Lot 2 DP 1137162 (10.44 ha) per development consent; all three buildings on one lot

lat.note: Geocoded from street address via NSW Spatial Services address point for 2 GLENDENNING ROAD GLENDENNING. Address point, not building centroid; campus spans a larger lot.

developer.note: Amazon bought 2 Glendenning Rd for $181m (settled 23 Dec 2022, source 17); w.media: 'reported to be an Amazon Web Services (AWS) development' (source 3). Formal SSD applicant is Lehr Consultants International (Australia) Pty Ltd (consent, source 12); planning documents do not name the operator

mw_it.note: DC01 IT capacity per EIS: 'A total IT capacity of approximately 193.6MW (DC01 - 79.2MW, DC02 - 35.2MW and DC03 - 79.2MW)'; same split in Submissions Report.

mw_grid.note: CAMPUS TOTAL, not apportioned per building: consent 'total power consumption of 235 megawatts'; assessment report 'Maximum power capacity 235 MW (IT load of 193.6 MW)'. SSD application form and portal description say 202.4 MW (application-stage figure)

cost_aud_m.note: CAMPUS TOTAL capital investment value $2,168,267,746 for all three stages (assessment report; EIS EDC identical). EIS gives Stage 1 (DC01) construction cost $571,013,322 (construction cost only, not CIV; source 13). SEARs request (Jul 2024) gave AUD2.3bn (source 16)

authority.value: NSW Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure (DPHI)
authority.note: consent authority Minister for Planning and Public Spaces; determined by A/Director, Industry Assessments under delegation

reference.note: single SSD covering all three stages

lodged.note: SSD application form 'Date Submitted: 21/03/2025' (EIS uploaded 2025-03-20). SEARs issued 25 Jul 2024; exhibited 16 May - 12 Jun 2025

determined.note: portal: Decision Approved, Determination Date 14/09/2026, Decider Director; consent signed 'Sydney 14 September 2026' (source 12). Consent documents uploaded to portal 2026-09-16

jobs_construction.note: EIS s1.6.1 for Stage 1 (DC01): construction cost $571,013,322, 3,726,613 total work hours over 53 months; 'The estimate of Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) jobs generated by Stage 1 is 400' (i.e. average daily work hours / 8; average FTE workforce over the stage, not peak)

jobs_construction_other.note: CAMPUS TOTAL (sum of the three stage FTE averages 400+333+343). Assessment report: 'up to 1,076 construction jobs' / '1,076 full-time equivalent construction jobs'; EIS: 'approximately 1,076 direct construction jobs'; application form 'Indicative Construction Jobs 1,076'
CAMPUS TOTAL. SEIA (Ethos Urban): 'directly support employment of 1,640 job-years' (based on $1.27bn direct construction cost)
CAMPUS TOTAL. SEIA: 'total state-wide economy effects ... employment of 8,720 job-years' (1,640 direct + 7,080 indirect)
CAMPUS TOTAL at SEARs request (Jul 2024): 'Indicative Construction Jobs 400'

jobs_operational.note: CAMPUS TOTAL, not apportioned. EIS s1.6.2: 'the total operational FTE employment roles for DC01, DC02 and DC03 is 106'; assessment report '106 operational jobs'

jobs_operational_other.note: CAMPUS TOTAL. SEIA: '124 direct FTE ongoing jobs once complete and fully operational' (differs from EIS figure 106)
CAMPUS TOTAL. SEIA: 'FTE employment of 218 jobs supported' (124 direct + 94 indirect)
CAMPUS TOTAL at SEARs request (Jul 2024): 'Indicative Operation Jobs 100'

construction_start.note: not announced; no post-approval documents on portal at 2026-09-27. Assessment report notes demolition 'already commenced under a separate complying development certificate' (CDC-25-00506). Stage 1 comprises site preparation, bulk earthworks for Stages 1-2 and DC01

construction_end.note: not announced. EIS jobs calculation assumes Stage 1 duration of 53 months; assessment report says 'each stage occurring over approximately 24 months'

open_questions: operator AWS rests on Amazon's 2022 purchase of the site and media reports; planning documents name only Lehr Consultants International as applicant
construction start and staging timetable (sequence of DC01-DC03 dates) not announced; builder not announced
